The procedure returns no result set. Translate the attached source faithfully, preserving all logic and behavior. Under identical input data, the PL/pgSQL procedure must produce the same final database state as the Oracle source, with the same control flow and the same null and edge-case handling. Do not add any behavior not present in the source.

Pay attention to PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL differences from Oracle PL/SQL, especially identifier case folding and quoting, cursor and row-processing idioms, %NOTFOUND versus NOT FOUND, and exception names. Do not add explicit exception handlers, commits, or rollbacks.

Return the complete stored procedure and nothing else.
